title: SQLite used but opened in :memory: mode (non-persistent)
evidence: server.js:2 requires sqlite3, server.js:12 new sqlite3.Database(':memory:') — real SQLite engine with schema/NOT NULL/prepared statements, but data does not persist across restarts; R7 how_to_verify explicitly flags 'not just in-memory state'
suggestion: Open a file-backed DB (e.g. new sqlite3.Database('books.db')) so data persists
